articles.title: KPop Demon Hunters Nears Billboard Record for Most Weeks at No. 1
articles.summary: The KPop Demon Hunters soundtrack has ruled Billboard's Top Soundtracks chart for 61 weeks — just one week short of the all-time record. Only one other soundtrack has ever held the top spot longer.

articles.title: Full Grown: The Company That Grows Furniture on Trees
articles.summary: In Derbyshire, England, Gavin and Alice Munro grow chairs and tables from living trees. Their method uses 25% of the energy of factory-made furniture and creates a wildlife sanctuary.

articles.title: Alcaraz Smiles Through 3:34 AM Loss, Calls for Schedule Change
articles.summary: Carlos Alcaraz lost a five-set US Open match at 3:34 a.m. — the latest finish in tournament history — but smiled because he was back after a five-month wrist injury. He wants matches to end by 11 p.m.
